title: Milk Keep Left on the Account in a CEP Refund — School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The keep of a CEP refund on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts milk bought on its own by how many times it was rung up on the account in the month before the refund date: four (4) or more purchases make a regular buyer, and the milk-only price is kept for every serving day left in the month of the refund date; one to three purchases keep once what the student spent on it in that month; no purchase keeps nothing.

A date falls within the N months before the refund date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the refund date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

| Times milk bought on its own was rung up in the month before the refund date | What is kept |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | the milk-only price (0.75) for every serving day left in the month |
| 1, 2 or 3 | what the student spent on it in that month, once |
| 0 | nothing |

## Both sides of the regular-buyer line (hypothetical)

- Four purchases in the month, with nine serving days in question: 0.75 for each of the nine days.
- Three purchases in the month: the three amounts actually paid, once, whatever the number of serving days.

## Serving days left in the month

The district's 2026-27 calendar serves meals on every weekday from August 12, 2026 through May 27, 2027, except Labor Day (September 7), October 12, the Thanksgiving week (November 23 through 27), the winter break (December 21 through January 1), January 18, February 15, the spring break (March 15 through 19) and March 26, and it serves no meals in June or July.

The serving days the keep counts left in the month of the refund date are the weekdays after the refund date through the last day of that month on which that calendar serves meals, less the calendar's closures that fall among them; a refund date before August 12, 2026 counts from August 12, 2026, and a refund date in July 2026 or after May 27, 2027 leaves none.

On hypothetical dates: a refund date of Tuesday, February 9, 2027 leaves 12 serving days in February; Wednesday, November 18, 2026 leaves 3; Friday, May 28, 2027 leaves none.
